title: Sections, not templates
description: Every page is a list of sections. Add one, reorder it, or hide it, and the layout keeps its spacing.

title: Edit in place
description: Click any headline, paragraph, or button on the canvas and type. Changes land in the page file, not a database.

title: Plain Blade underneath
description: Sections are Blade components with props. Open them in your editor, version them in git, deploy them like anything else.

title: Content as collections
description: Plans, features, and testimonials are JSON rows. Edit them once and every section that reads them follows.

title: Every screen, checked
description: Preview at phone, tablet, and desktop widths without leaving the editor. Nothing ships squished.
